contexts.text: The evil Spirits who excite man's reasonings...
Evil Spirits excite all the depraved inclinations and thoughts...
Evil Spirits excite the remembrance of all man's falsities and evils...
With every man there are two evil Spirits... who excite his evils.
When evil Spirits try to act anything of evil, or to speak falsity, that is, to excite them, they are at once in infernal fear.
Every man communicates with Hell through evil Spirits; hence the evil that is with him is excited.
Evil Spirits never excite anything but the evils and falsities of man...
It is evil which the infernal Spirits excite.
The words with which (Spirits) speak, that is, which they excite or take out of the memory of man...
The Lord could not but know... what evil Spirits excited (the evil and falsity).
It is evil Spirits who excite evils and falsities; and unless they were excited, man would scarcely know that they exist.
The thought is kept in truths... and thus are excited many things which are related and suitable...
For nothing can be excited with man but that which moves his sense.
(Then) the evil Spirits excite the falsities he has thought and the evils he has done...
(Then) unclean Spirits excite the evils and falsities which are with him...
The fallacies and falsities which, in a state of temptations, are excited by evil Genii and Spirits. Signified.
A state of temptation takes place in this way: these loves are excited by the infernal crew... and then the affections of truth and good are excited by the Angels...
(Thus) when this good is excited, there is at once excited the scientific with which it is conjoined.
(In order to domineer) they excite enmities, etc., among others.
The evil are (therefore) more easily excited (to perform uses) than the upright.
They know that such things are excited with them by Hell...

When the man of the Spiritual Church is being regenerated, the truths with him are excited by the Lord through Angels, and thus he is led into good; but when he is regenerate, truth and good are excited at the same time, and he is thus led.

When truths are disposed into this form, they act as one with good; and then when the one is excited by the Lord, the other is excited; namely, when the things of faith are excited, the things which are of charity are excited, and vice versa.
When Spirits come to a man, they enter into the whole of his memory, and excite thence things suitable to themselves.
When such objects flow in, the filthy things which are in the Sensuous are excited...
The power of exciting the falsities of cupidities by presence with those who infest. Signified. That it is excitation by presence...
The filthy things of cupidities together with blasphemies are excited... when Divine truth flows in, and Heaven approaches nearer. Signified, Explained.
The more nearly that Heaven approaches them, the more the interior evils and falsities with them are excited...
Temptations are induced by evil Spirits... These excite his evils, and accuse him. AC 8960.
This new Voluntary, which is from the good of innocence, is the dwelling place through which the Lord enters with man, and excites the man to will good, and, from willing, to do good...

The scientifics of the memory are in like manner excited by the delight of the man's love, but by the mediumship of the Intellectual part: that which has become the man's life... excites these things...
The parents themselves excite their children to such combats.
They are excited by the love of self...
When this heat flows in with a man it excites with him cupidities; and with the evil, hatreds and revenges; and with the sick, insanities.
Spirit = the excitation of life. Illustrated.
Force is excited endeavour.
There, every love, when excited, appears at a distance like fire...
Wives are not in excitation, as men are. Explained.
Unless heat is united to light... nothing... is excited...
On the excitation of the things in the memory... by Spirits. SE 1662:2.
That Spirits of a like quality and affection (to himself) are excited by man.
How the case is with the excitations of cupidities with those who are in faith.

There are spiritual ideas which constitute the speech of Spirits, and which when they inflow into the memory of man, excite words corresponding to the ideas, and similar ones, which the man has in his memory... For Spirits excite ideas, and therefore words, which are in agreement with their nature...
That in the World of Spirits the one is excited by the other, almost as one man is by another.
When any thing obscene and filthy was excited...
So many excitements of their endeavours, forces, and cupidities...
So that nothing could be excited by one that would disturb any series of thoughts.
They tried to... excite thoughts which disturb the quietude. SE 2342:end.

Man's ideas contain indefinite things... all of which are wont to be excited... When I was thinking of one thing, the things in the idea and near the idea were excited by the Spirits, and that variously...
For when the affection of anyone is excited, he is excited.
Who are then excited to punish...
The Spirits round me insisted that they... excited the life in themselves, supposing that they excited the objects of the thoughts...
All the cupidities and Falsities in him who is in faith in the Lord are not excited by him; but by Spirits...
There exhaled from him so much subtle poison, that it excited the deceitful and more deceitful Sirens.
He then excited all the men or Spirits I had known... In a word, he excited persons or Spirits who were far away from my ideas... SE 3404. SE 3405.
That evil Spirits... cannot excite those who are asleep.
Entice... by the excitation of mercy...
They excite (novitiates) who are almost dead.
Suppose that all things are their own, and are not excited by Spirits.

Such could excite from my memory all the venereal things I had ever thought of... Not only with man, but also with Spirits, they could at the same time excite from their memory their corporeal and venereal things... for the efficacy of their sphere is so great, that it penetrates even into the corporeal memory of Spirits.
The objection occurs, that evils are excited by evil Spirits, and are hindered by the Angels...
How truths and goods are excited by the Lord.
They are thus excited by Spirits...
(I said to them) that thought excites affections; but this is when they are cupidities; then thoughts excite them...
As the Spirits objected... that thus life does not flow in from the Lord, but is excited by the objects which are seen...
So that when one idea is excited, another which is near and related can be produced...

a. While a Spirit is in persuasion, he at once excites from the man's memory the confirmatory things which are in the memory of the man; for the persuasion of a thing excites... Therefore such as is the persuasion of the man, such is that of the Spirit; the Spirit continually excites confirmatory things. SE 4115.
On the... excitation of ideas with man.

When this sphere acts into the memory of a man, it excites thence whatever agrees... When such a sphere reigns, all things which are excited, even the falsest, appear as truths... I marvelled... for it is nothing but their general sphere which excites.
I was shown by living experience how Spirits excite the thoughts of men; they speak as man thinks...
On a certain kind of explorers, who excite the filthy things of evil Spirits.
He excited the most filthy things with even the profane infernals...
The spiritual love nudity, and it excites.

Lasciviousness was excited in me... (The Spirits) then said Rua raha, which means the excitation of the lasciviousness of that part... They were afterwards affected by my intense look... and then pronounced the words, Ura raha, which means the excitation of the look.
By looking around them, they excited the Spirits on every side.
The excitation of adultery is external...
There was a Spirit who could excite the upright, and also the Angels...
As he stirred up the dust there...
Many kings shall he stirred up from the sides of the earth ().
To lie down = that he is in security from all falsity and evil; and therefore it is said Who shall rouse him up? ().
The good of truth is expressed by being stirred up with the psaltery ().
I will stir up one who comes from the north... ().
I will stir up My judgment for a light of the people (). Explained.
I have stirred him up in righteousness (). Explained. AE 811:19.
The restoration of the Church... is signified by Awake, awake, rise up, Jerusalem (). AE 1057:4.
I will stir up the Chaldeans...
As Divine truth has all power, it is said, Awake, awake, put on thy strength, Zion ().
They are led by the Lord through Heaven, and thence by the excitation of their will and at the same time of their understanding.
All things are excited from the ultimate...
For this reason the Lord stirred up so many men who attacked it; He stirred up Sweden, etc. to receive... He stirred up Gustavus Adolphus...
